name: Claude Certified Architect — Foundations
description: Foundations-level certification covering agentic architecture, tool design and the Model Context Protocol, prompt engineering and context management, and Claude Code configuration and workflows.
sourceNote: Exam format and domain weights are taken from a third-party prep guide, not from published Anthropic material. Verify against official certification documentation before relying on them.

domains.name: Agentic Architecture & Orchestration
domains.description: How an agent gathers context, acts, and verifies results, and how work is decomposed across one or many agents.

domains.name: Tool Design & Model Context Protocol
domains.description: The tool use API, MCP server and client architecture, and what separates a tool definition a model can use from one it cannot.

subtopics.name: Tool use API and stop reasons

domains.name: Prompt Engineering & Context Management
domains.description: Structuring system prompts, getting reliable structured output, review loops, and working within a finite context window.

subtopics.name: System prompt structure and XML tagging

domains.name: Claude Code Configuration & Workflows
domains.description: Configuring Claude Code and the Agent SDK: memory files, hooks, permissions, slash commands, and MCP integration.
